description.value: The study estimated effective connectivity among default mode, salience, and central executive network regions using dynamic causal modeling of resting-state fMRI in cognitively normal, EMCI, LMCI, and Alzheimer's disease groups, and examined group differences and prediction of cognitive scores.

design.value: A retrospective longitudinal ADNI-2 resting-state fMRI study comparing four stable progression-stage groups (CN, EMCI, LMCI, and AD) using subject-level DCM, parametric empirical Bayes, Bayesian model reduction, ANOVA, and linear regression.

task_description.value: During the fMRI scans, all participants were instructed to keep their eyes open and relax.

instructions.value: Keep their eyes open and relax.

description.value: Resting-state functional images were obtained using an echo-planar imaging sequence. Each series has 140 volumes, and each volume consists of 48 slices of image matrices with dimensions 64 × 64.

The first 10 volumes of each functional time series were discarded. The remaining 130 volumes were corrected for the staggered order of slice acquisition. Preprocessing also included regression of head motion parameters, realignment for head movement, and spatial normalization using T1 image unified segmentation to the Montreal Neurological Institute (MNI) space.

steps.value: Discarded the first 10 volumes of each functional time series.
Correction for the staggered order of slice acquisition.
Spatial normalization using T1 image unified segmentation to the Montreal Neurological Institute (MNI) space.

model_settings.value: The DCM included a neuronal model and a generalized BOLD observation model. Seven ROI nodes were used: mPFC, bilateral PCC, bilateral dlPFC, and bilateral ACC. ROI activity was summarized by extracting time series at all voxels within an 8 mm radius sphere around each associated MNI coordinate. For resting state, stimulus u was usually set to zero.

estimator.value: Parametric empirical Bayes (PEB), with Bayesian Model Reduction (BMR) to control switching on and off of each connection and estimate connectivity parameters

model_settings.value: Connectivity strengths for the four subject groups were compared; Bonferroni correction was applied for multiple comparisons.

Forward step-wise linear regression was used for MMSE. Both forward and backward connections between L-dlPFC and mPFC were predictive of CDR; the reported MMSE model explained 11.5% of variance and the CDR model explained 12.1% of variance.

estimator.value: forward step-wise linear regression; both forward and backward regression procedures for CDR
